issues.problem: ZH 「一线证据」（a shred/thread of evidence, i.e. limited evidence) is rendered as "a piece of hard evidence", which sounds stronger and more solid than the Chinese hedge.
issues.suggestion: Change "a piece of hard evidence" to "a thread of evidence" or "some evidence".

overall: The English edition matches the Chinese field by field in facts, numbers, names, quotes, attributions, hedges and attributions of inference; apart from one slightly strengthened wording in the 'today' section, there are no real content differences.
